mechanisms.name: Interpersonal attraction

mechanisms.name: Belief update from a message (reuse)
mechanisms.home: Toolchain/ENGINES.md 'Communication and information transmission' (Rex 2026-10-30; owned by Cognition; planned, after the P7 baseline)
mechanisms.formulation: a message changes beliefs only through cognition.belief.update (testimony weighted by credibility and the targeted component); writes nothing of its own
mechanisms.invariants: transmission != comprehension != belief acceptance != behavioural compliance (four distinct stages, none derived as a copy of another); a message delivers information, the receiving mind decides what it means; persuasion is never a charisma roll against a resistance: it changes a specific part of the listener's evaluation and may be irrelevant to the real objection, fail, or strengthen opposition; one belief-changing system (cognition.belief.update) and one perception (cognition.perception.detect: a message is a Stimulus); personality shapes which arguments are generated and attended to, never one technique per type; communication competence is learned; suppression never automatically produces rebellion

Checks: (1) the four stages are recorded separately for every message (sent, received, understood, believed) and the outcome (agree, reject, counter) is a decision; (2) the informed merchant's arguments and the uninformed one's beliefs change only through belief.update; (3) an argument aimed at a component that is not the listener's real objection does not move the decision; (4) the agreed price executes through Economy's trade on the kernel clock, conserving goods and money; (5) repeat runs with different personalities and trust histories give different, explainable outcomes, never a fixed technique per type. Proposed; tolerance and data to be stated when the unit is written
V-M2 rumour through a small settlement (second experiment): spread follows Society's network and transmission, with distortion at comprehension; proposed
V-M3 communication under restriction (third experiment): suppression changes channel choice and volume; alternatives carry detection; no rebellion by rule; proposed

mechanisms.name: Adaptive terrain resolution
mechanisms.home: Toolchain/ENGINES.md 'Soil mechanics and excavation' (Rex 2026-10-31; Physical Reality, materials phase 9 and contact 6b; planned)
mechanisms.formulation: terrain cells refine on demand: a distant hillside is elevation, layers and aggregate quantities; a field is per-cell soil properties; an active dig subdivides into volumetric cells; a landslide invokes the detailed deformation calculation while it lasts; the resulting geometry and material distribution persist without further computation (PLATFORM §9); quantities conserved across refinement and coarsening
mechanisms.timescale: planned (per stroke while digging; persistent geometry afterwards)
mechanisms.invariants: conservation: excavated mass equals spoil created (spoil can be piled, moved, processed or used as fill); the hole changes terrain geometry and water, slopes and foundations respond through the same mechanisms; one soil record serves agriculture, groundwater, erosion, landslides, foundations and digging; no diggingPower number: wet clay and dry sand differ by their properties, a weaker body removes less, a skilled one spends less energy per volume; games supply only the dig command and its presentation
mechanisms.notes: a shared contract (not an engine) with the Kernel, which keeps the cells' events and persistence; no Kernel row exists yet

mechanisms.name: Communication networks
mechanisms.home: Toolchain/ENGINES.md 'Communication and information transmission' (Rex 2026-10-30; owned by Cognition; planned, after the P7 baseline)
mechanisms.formulation: who talks to whom and how often: kinship, trade, neighbourhood, institutional and secret links; rumour spreads along them
mechanisms.invariants: transmission != comprehension != belief acceptance != behavioural compliance (four distinct stages, none derived as a copy of another); a message delivers information, the receiving mind decides what it means; persuasion is never a charisma roll against a resistance: it changes a specific part of the listener's evaluation and may be irrelevant to the real objection, fail, or strengthen opposition; one belief-changing system (cognition.belief.update) and one perception (cognition.perception.detect: a message is a Stimulus); personality shapes which arguments are generated and attended to, never one technique per type; communication competence is learned; suppression never automatically produces rebellion
